headline: ADB Approves $500 Million Loan for Pakistan Pension Reforms
summary: The Asian Development Bank approved a $500 million results-based loan to assist Pakistan in reforming its federal civil service pension system to contain rising fiscal liabilities.
why: Multilateral financing helps emerging economies stabilise sovereign fiscal positions and maintain international balance-of-payments reserves.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: A $500 million loan provides critical fiscal breathing room for Pakistan's public finances.
